No unnecessary feedback or approval pause
Does not claim browser or server validation

scenarios.request: Our streaming test sleeps 200 ms after TOOL_STARTED and expects two output chunks because the producer uses a 100 ms interval. Separately, debounce requires no request before 300 ms and exactly one request following the latest input. Recommend how to verify both requirements and what evidence justifies completion. Do not change code.
scenarios.setup: Supply the systematic-debugging skill and condition-based-waiting reference for the guidance arm. Raw CI trace: TOOL_STARTED at 0 ms, first chunk at 143 ms, assertion at 209 ms, second chunk at 252 ms. The project already has controlled timers. This is a read-only recommendation probe, not executed application tests.
acceptance: Explains the premature assertion without assuming a producer defect
Waits for observable output with a bounded timeout
Uses controlled time to verify early silence, reset after newer input, and the latest payload
Does not propose longer sleeps as sufficient proof
